scope: R212: the FA kernel is bit-reproducible too, closing the R211 claim and pointing issue 15 squarely at the prefetch machinery

why_r211b_failed.error: sequence length must be a positive multiple of 16, even at seq 4096
why_r211b_failed.root_cause: fa910a.py unpacks b, h, source_n, d = q.shape, so the layout is B,H,N,D
why_r211b_failed.my_mistake: I passed (1, seq, heads, hd) which made h=41792 and source_n=7, and 7 % 16 != 0
why_r211b_failed.fix: use (1, 7, 41792, 128), the real per-rank shape from R159

results.note: the real per-rank shape accounting for 41.5 percent of a step

three_layer_refutation.conclusion: HCCL all-reduce bit-reproducible, 8 ranks, three real widths
matmul at four real GEMM shapes, sum, max, RMSNorm, add, softmax all bit-reproducible
bit-reproducible including the real shape at 41.5 percent of a step

three_layer_refutation.contrast: yet the full 50-block DiT differs by relRMS 0.026 percent

conclusion: the maths, the collectives and the largest operator are all deterministic, so the difference must come from the layer that composes them

narrowed_candidates.candidate: asynchronous weight offload and prefetch racing computation
narrowed_candidates.fit: highest - per-block offload moves 32.3 GB every step, and a prefetch of block i+1 overwriting block i still in use would produce exactly this
high, since the operator tests were all single stream
medium, tiling is proven deterministic but addresses might still matter
medium, HCCL is deterministic but the interleaving may not be

reinterpretation_of_15_and_4.new: after refuting three layers, 15s difference most likely originates inside the prefetch and copy machinery that 4 governs, making them two faces of one problem where 4s mechanism is the remedy
reinterpretation_of_15_and_4.value: issue 4s basis moves from guesswork to known-single-remaining-suspect

recommended_next_step: compare repeatability with prefetch on versus off: block-by-block synchronous copies should be bit-reproducible if prefetch is the root cause, which would confirm it and simultaneously define issue 4s safe implementation boundary
limits: the operator and FA tests are single card and single stream, so they cannot detect multi-card or multi-stream interleaving; this both grounds and bounds the inference
4 to 10 repeats may be too few for very low frequency jitter, though the real DiT 0.026 percent is stable so it is probably high frequency
I did not check whether changing addresses changes matmul tiling, which is the allocator candidate
